name: cooking
description: Weight/thaw-based timed cooking at stoves (flags.stove_tier) or a carried portable oven (tags.portable_oven). `cook <food|vessel>` — background/lazy, no tick; a bounded set of timers narrate stage transitions and completion, rescheduled on boot. Food tagged `food_profile` adds depth: a peak window, a burn point, handling (`flip`/`stir`), and a quality band stamped by `plate` that scales the meal's effects and awards Cooking IP. Owns the shared `cook` verb and routes drug-cooking to plugins/synthesis via the `synthesis.cook` Action; a room holding both a stove and a chem lab disambiguates through SIFT. `heat` is an alias.

cook.note: Shared verb. Routes target-first: a carried needs_cooking/vessel item is food, anything else is a synthesis recipe. Bare `cook` in a room with both a stove and a chem lab raises a SIFT station prompt, replayed through the cooking.station_choice Action.

extensionPoints: Cookbook tablet app (plugins/tablet/cookbook-app.js) reads the cookbook: player_flags.
